title: Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical [MASK] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. translated_title: 超越硬词元：面向多模态蛋白质生成的预测记忆
translated_abstract: 多模态蛋白质语言模型通过迭代式掩码解码，将序列与离散结构词元统一起来，为蛋白质联合设计提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，标准解码器在每次迭代时依赖于无记忆的掩码重置机制：只有稀疏的一小部分新提交的硬词元会被传递下去，而其余所有未确定的位点都被重置为相同的 [MASK] 嵌入。在开放式的协同生成场景中，由于没有任何模态能提供固定的外部锚点，这种无状态的转换限制了单步细化的深度，并使两条生成轨道都缺乏稳定的跨步软锚点，从而导致收敛缓慢或退化为重复性坍塌。我们观察到，未提交的预测会以显著的时间连贯性演化，而非无规则的噪声，据此提出了预测记忆，这是一种无需训练的自条件化递归机制，能够在解码步骤之间传递这些软性信念。在每一步，PredMem 会对原始的……
tldr: 该论文提出了PredMem——一种无需训练的自条件化递归机制，通过在迭代掩码解码的各步骤间传递未提交的软预测作为跨步记忆，解决了多模态蛋白质生成中收敛缓慢与重复性坍塌的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PredMem, a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries soft uncommitted predictions across decoding steps as memory, resolving slow convergence and repetitive collapse in multimodal protein generation.
